Sanjay Dutt Clarifies 'No Peace in India' Remark

Actor Sanjay Dutt has clarified remarks attributed to him stating he "don't feel peace in India," asserting that these are not his views and that he has never said this. The clarification comes amid a controversy that arose from the alleged statement.
